description: Climate and Environment: source-cited place dossiers of air-quality and climate series, grid generation/load/unavailability, industrial facilities, emissions trading and Umweltatlas layers over shared Geospatial, LEI, source-runtime and subscription providers. Observations, model output and forecasts stay distinct. Replaces the retired energy example pack.

profiles.description: Biodiversity: a taxon or place to cited occurrence records with dataset provenance, licence and coordinate uncertainty, and conservation assessments with their history

vocabulary.occurrence: one published record (gbifID) with its dataset, licence and precision as released
vocabulary.taxon: a name usage in one checklist release; provider keys stay separate
vocabulary.generalised: coordinates coarsened or withheld by the publisher; never refined
vocabulary.assessment: one Red List assessment at citation level; the assessor designates the current one

workflow_defaults.as_of: records retrieved on or before the date
workflow_defaults.counts: counts of records returned only; never abundance or presence/absence
workflow_defaults.never: No distribution modelling, abundance estimation, de-generalised locations or Noesis-derived threat status.

profiles.description: Water and hydrology: a place, river or station to gauging stations, cited water levels and discharge with quality states, and the status history of its water bodies per reporting cycle

vocabulary.station: a gauging station or monitoring location keyed by its published id (and number)
vocabulary.observation: one published value with unit, time and quality state (provisional or approved)
vocabulary.gauge zero: the published height reference of a level series, with its validity
vocabulary.reporting cycle: one WFD reporting of a water body's status; cycles are never merged

workflow_defaults.as_of: revisions retrieved on or before the date
workflow_defaults.missing: values not published stay missing; never interpolated
workflow_defaults.never: No flood forecasting, gap filling, own status assessments or flood-risk scores.
